alerts.title: Next water turn Monday 23 Nov
alerts.why: Wheat is emerging. Soil at 98%, above the 50% refill point. No rain in the forecast.
steps: Water on your turn Monday, early morning.
alerts.voice: الأرض فيها مية كفاية لحد دورك يوم الاتنين.

alerts.title: Little rust weather this week
alerts.why: 0 of the last 7 nights were foggy and humid. Nights 12 to 15 °C. Your variety resists rust well.
steps: From January, walk the field once a week.
alerts.source: Rust weather index, NASA POWER and Open-Meteo humidity and dew point

alerts.title: New satellite image: your field looks even
alerts.why: No square is less green than the rest of your field in the last two clear images.
alerts.voice: صورة القمر الصناعي الجديدة: الأرض كلها شكلها كويس.

alerts.title: Weeding starts around 4 Dec
alerts.why: Weeks 3 to 6 after sowing are the critical weed-free period for wheat sown 13 Nov.
steps: Hoe or hand weed before fertilizing.
alerts.voice: نضّف الأرض من الحشايش لحد يوم 25.

alerts.title: No heat risk this week
alerts.why: Highs of 26 to 28 °C. Wheat is not yet at a heat sensitive stage.
